construct.name: Bounded NERO employment-stock index, General Clerks, Capital Region
construct.definition: Modelled employment stock x transformed to x/(x+4217); exposure context, not vacancies or worker opportunity

estimand.quantity: NERO modelled employed-person count x divided by x plus the frozen August 2026 count 4217
estimand.population: NERO occupation code 5311, General Clerks, resident in SA4 code 101, Capital Region
estimand.denominator: x plus frozen August 2026 count 4217; not a population denominator
estimand.aggregation_level: One occupation-SA4 series; no aggregation across occupations or regions

scope.population: NERO occupation code 5311, General Clerks, resident in SA4 code 101, Capital Region
scope.denominator: x plus frozen August 2026 count 4217; not a population denominator
scope.aggregation_level: One occupation-SA4 series; no aggregation across occupations or regions

timing.revision_behaviour: Freeze the August input vintage and first retained October release; retain corrections separately.

known_limits: Stock is not vacancies, worker opportunity, actual GP access, agency or AI causation.
Occupation and SA4 versions are not independently established by the retained archive.

missingness.mechanism: A source release or exact series cell may be absent, suppressed or changed.
missingness.reporting_rule: Withhold resolution when the exact cell cannot be reconstructed; never impute zero.

negative_controls: The fixed equal-probability comparator uses the same source eligibility checks.

risks: selecting a favourable vintage or series after observing it
gaming.detection: Compare frozen code, scope, first-presence receipt and archive hashes.
gaming.suspension_rule: Withhold for ambiguous classifications or conflicting first-release bytes.

reflexivity.risk: A modelled stock may be mistaken for accessible work.
reflexivity.monitor: Keep the stock, access and agency interpretations distinct.

value_of_information.learning_value: Test whether a prospective modelled-stock claim can be resolved faithfully.
value_of_information.next_observation: First retained October 2026 NERO release for occupation 5311 and SA4 101.

metric_contract.measure: NERO modelled employed-person count x divided by x plus the frozen August 2026 count 4217
metric_contract.denominator: x plus frozen August 2026 count 4217; not a population denominator
metric_contract.population: NERO occupation code 5311, General Clerks, resident in SA4 code 101, Capital Region
metric_contract.aggregation: One occupation-SA4 series; no aggregation across occupations or regions
metric_contract.evaluation_rule: Transform the exact series count x to x/(x+4217), then compare gte 0.5. No population-share interpretation.

signals.public_claim_ceiling: Bounded NERO employment-stock index, General Clerks, Capital Region may be described only as derived-estimate evidence about NERO modelled employed-person count x divided by x plus the frozen August 2026 count 4217 for NERO occupation code 5311, General Clerks, resident in SA4 code 101, Capital Region, SA4 101: Capital Region, Australia, during 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z. It does not establish causality, individual outcomes or action authority.
